text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити's summer camp has come to an
end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but I don't fully trust
your
enthusiasm.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm being serious. Although, I do feel I
got
something out of this.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I think I'm starting to look forward to the
Kikuka
Sho. I'll try to make them...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: No, I'll definitely make them say the words I want to hear!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tama! How many more laps are you
gonna
run?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
Time to get ready—you're gonna miss
the bus!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
This is it! I got it! I found da key to
victory!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Everyone who's looked down on me's
'bout to find
out who I really am!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
And so, summer camp—filled with its
whirlwind of
emotions—comes to an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
